shortDescription: Uniper SE agreed to sell its stake in Germany’s Opal gas pipeline to Ardian SAS-backed investor Hy24, according to Bloomberg.The sale fulfills another European Union condition tied to Uniper’s state bailout.

title: Uniper Agrees to Sell Opal Gas Pipeline Stake to Hy24
